# FIXTURE rule source for tests only. Not a real design-system document.
tokens: tokens.css is the token file
R1 never inline styles with hex values
R2 Never hardcode hex values.
R3 must have an associated label
R4 images need alt
R5 not span or div with onClick
R6 icon buttons need aria-label
R7 alert messages are announced
R8 spinners sit in a live region
R9 No skipped levels
R10 modals need role dialog
contrast needs the rendered page
